notes: The doubled them is read as one discontinuous realization of αὐτούς under rule 15, rule 103 naming a resumptive pronoun as exactly what rule 7 folds; marking the first them added is excluded by that same clause.

τῶν governs both coordinate genitives and is spent on the first of the; the repeated the before Jews is a rule 7 helper on the noun under rule 103's repeated-function-word clause, with of riding along under rule 21's determinerless clause.
ὑβρίσαι → to treat them shamefully heads on shamefully, the meaning-bearing complement of the support frame.
